headline: We could not find a Google Maps card for WMRanch Equine, White Mountains Ranch, or Cari Johnson.
summary: WMRanch Equine is Cari Johnson's barefoot trimming, boot fitting, saddle fitting, and equine nutrition practice in Lakeside. Your site is current, with 2026 pricing and a clear way to reach you by email. The leftover is Google: we searched Maps for WMRanch Equine, White Mountains Ranch Lakeside, Cari Johnson hoof care, (619) 867-6080, and 14895 Willow Rd, and found no card for your business, so someone searching Google for a barefoot trimmer near Lakeside sees boarding barns and riding schools instead.

signals.note: On Google Maps we searched WMRanch Equine, White Mountains Ranch Lakeside CA, Cari Johnson hoof care, (619) 867-6080, and 14895 Willow Rd, Lakeside. None turned up a card for your business. The searches showed Lakeside boarding stables and riding schools, a White Mountain Ranch in another part of the state, and a plain address pin.
signals.next: Set up a free Google Business Profile as a service-area business, so you can show the area you trim in without listing a home address.

signals.note: Your site asks new clients to email whitemountainsranch@gmail.com and does not print a phone number. Directories list (619) 867-6080.
signals.next: Use the same inbox, and a phone if you want calls, on a Google card.

signals.note: Your site explains the 4 to 6 week trim cycle but does not list the days you work, and there is no Google card to show them.
signals.next: Add the days you take appointments.

signals.note: Your site has a portfolio page. Without a Google card, none of those photos show up in a Google search.
signals.next: Put a few before and after hoof photos on a Google card once it is set up.

signals.note: wmr-equine.com is live with 2026 pricing (standard horses $75), the services you offer, and what you ask of clients.
signals.next: Nothing big. One small typo in the Boot Fitting section, if you want it.

signals.note: The site uses WMRanch Equine, WMR Equine, and White Mountains Ranch, and signs off Cari Johnson - Barefoot Trimmer - Lakeside CA. Your street address appears only in directories.
signals.next: Pick the name you want customers to search for and use it on a new Google card.
